Our story

A tree that has always been here.

Anyone who travels the Algarve crosses paths with carob trees at every turn. For thousands of years, Mediterranean peoples have gathered their pods, for the table and for the animals, and many regional sweets use carob as a main ingredient: it is sweet and tastes a little like cocoa.

More than 40 years ago, Joaquim’s grandmother made carob tea at home. Many years later, Joaquim Lourenço recreated that infusion from memory and realised no one was selling it, neither in Portugal nor in Spain. That is how Alkarub was born.

Today we select, dry and grind the pods in small batches and pack everything by hand, in the Algarve. That’s why every order takes its time.

We use the Mulata and Preta de Lagos varieties, native to the Algarve, chosen for their abundant pulp and the pod’s natural sugars. Our carob has organic certification, and we’re working towards Alkarub tea having that certification too, soon.

Joaquim Lourenço Founder of Alkarub · 53 years old

I'm an entrepreneur by nature — driven by the urge to make things, try them out, and start over whenever needed. I'm passionate about things that seem to have no value: that's how Alkarub was born, from a pod that almost everyone let fall to the ground, and that my grandmother knew how to turn into a special tea.

A Mediterranean superfood

Much more than a tasty tea.

Carob has been used for centuries in the Mediterranean as a nutritious food. These are its main qualities, based on the pod’s recognised nutritional characteristics.

Rich in fibre

The pod is naturally rich in dietary fibre, which helps with satiety and healthy digestion.

Natural antioxidants

Contains polyphenols and tannins, compounds with antioxidant properties that help fight free radicals.

Energy without stimulants

The pod’s natural sugars give a gentle energy boost, with no caffeine or theine — ideal for any time of day.

Source of minerals

Provides minerals naturally present in the pod, such as calcium, potassium, magnesium and iron.

No caffeine, no gluten

A good option for anyone cutting down on caffeine, sensitive to gluten, or looking for a lighter alternative to chocolate.

Mediterranean tradition

Used for millennia in the Mediterranean as a food and traditional home remedy, long before being rediscovered as a superfood.

Natural sugar from the pod

The Mulata and Preta de Lagos varieties are rich in pulp and in the pod’s own natural sugars, traditionally considered easier to tolerate than regular sugar — but anyone with diabetes should always consult their doctor.

Certified organic carob

The pods we use are organically certified. Alkarub tea is on its way to also having that certification, soon.

This information is nutritional and traditional in nature. Alkarub is a food and does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment — for health questions, including diabetes, always consult a professional.

Recipes

Beyond the cup.

Simple ideas for enjoying Alkarub hot, cold, or in the kitchen.

How to prepare · hot5 to 7 minutes

One tea bag or two teaspoons in 250 ml of freshly boiled water. Drink it plain or with plant milk, for a creamier cup.

How to prepare · iced1 to 2 hours chilled

Prepare as for hot, let it cool, and chill in the fridge. Serve over ice with citrus or mint.

5 MIN · HOT

Carob latte

A creamy, cocoa-flavoured latte, caffeine-free.

See recipe

Ingredients

  • 2 teaspoons of Alkarub Original
  • 150 ml water
  • 100 ml milk or plant milk
  • Cinnamon to taste

Method

  1. Steep for 5 to 7 minutes in 150 ml of boiling water.
  2. Heat and froth the milk.
  3. Strain the infusion, add the milk and dust with cinnamon.
10 MIN + CHILL · ICED

Iced orange carob tea

Refreshing for hot Algarve days.

See recipe

Ingredients

  • 4 Alkarub Orange tea bags
  • 1 litre water
  • Orange slices
  • Ice and mint leaves

Method

  1. Steep in 500 ml of hot water for 8 minutes.
  2. Add 500 ml cold water and chill in the fridge.
  3. Serve with ice, orange and mint.
5 MIN · HOT

Evening rosemary and honey

An aromatic cup for after dinner.

See recipe

Ingredients

  • 1 Alkarub Rosemary tea bag
  • 250 ml water
  • 1 teaspoon strawberry-tree honey
  • Lemon zest

Method

  1. Steep for 5 minutes with the lemon zest.
  2. Remove the tea bag and sweeten with honey to taste.
NIGHT BEFORE · BREAKFAST

Carob overnight oats

Prepare it the night before and breakfast is ready.

See recipe

Ingredients

  • 40 g rolled oats
  • 150 ml Alkarub Original infusion, cold
  • 1 plain yoghurt
  • Figs or banana and chopped almonds

Method

  1. Mix the oats with the infusion and yoghurt.
  2. Chill in the fridge overnight.
  3. In the morning, add the fruit and almonds.

      Frequently asked questions
      How does ordering work?

      You choose the products, send the order, and we reply by email confirming availability and with payment instructions. You don’t pay anything on the site.

      How long does it take?

      Alkarub is made in small batches. Once we receive payment, we ship via CTT (the Portuguese postal service) within 4 to 5 business days.

      How much is shipping?

      In Portugal, shipping is €5, free above €30. For Europe, shipping is €9, free above €75.

      Does carob have health benefits?

      Carob is traditionally used in the Mediterranean as a nutritious food: it is rich in fibre and in polyphenols with antioxidant properties, and is a natural source of calcium, potassium and magnesium. It is also naturally caffeine- and gluten-free. These are nutritional characteristics of the food — Alkarub does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

      Is it organic? Which varieties do you use?

      The pods we use are organically certified, and we’re working towards Alkarub tea also having that certification soon. We use the Mulata and Preta de Lagos varieties, native to the Algarve, chosen for their abundant pulp and natural sugars.

      What’s in each package?

      Original is 100% carob. May contain traces of tree nuts. The tea bags are biodegradable and contain no microplastic. Store in a cool, dry place.

      Can I return it?

      As this is a food product, we only accept returns of unopened or defective packages. Email us at info@alkarub.pt and we’ll sort it out.
